artist.name: Rajah Betta
artist.bio: Rajah Betta is a DJ, producer and radio host born in Bombay who developed his sound in New York, where he hosted Betta Sounds on Brooklyn's Newtown Radio, before moving back to India in 2025. He calls his blend of club music and Bombay samples "Bombay Club". In 2026 he appeared on Padmini Records' Yaar-Dost vol. 2 and released the two-track EP Offcuts on Stereo Ferment.

eras.sound: Bombay-meets-Brooklyn club music with film samples
